# Tachylite showcase

These pages show what a note can do in Tachylite. Every name, number and plant in them is made up. Copy any page as a starting point.

> [!tip] Try search
> Open Find and type `quince`. Find lists each note whose text holds the word, with the match marked.

## The pages

| Page | What it shows |
|---|---|
| [[Allotment plan]] | Properties, callouts, a table, a footnote, highlights, tags, an image |
| [[Allotment tasks]] | The four task statuses, nested tasks, tasks in a callout |
| [[Planting calendar]] | Mermaid diagrams, code, a folded block, a figure with a caption |
| [[Harvest report]] | A report as an agent would write it: a summary, an embedded chart, an embedded note |
| [[Soil test]] | A short note that other notes embed and link to. Its foot lists them, as backlinks |
| [[Rendering limits]] | What shows as plain text, so nobody writes it by mistake |
| [[harvest-chart.html]] | A standalone page with a chart and a script |
| [[bed-map.html]] | A standalone page to tap |

## Which form to pick

1. **A Markdown note** for nearly everything. It links, lists its backlinks, updates as it is saved, and Find searches its text.
2. **Raw HTML inside a note** for a folded block, a figure or a keyboard key. [[Planting calendar]] has each.
3. **A standalone `.html` page** for a chart, or anything with a script. [[Harvest report]] embeds one and links to another.

The `tachylite-vault` skill holds the full rules.
